summary: This filing is a Form 6-K reporting the results of JIADE Limited's annual general meeting held on May 4, 2026. Shareholders approved ordinary resolutions to re-elect five directors (Yuan Li, Xiaohui Li, Shuang Qiu, Yi Chen, Shang Wu) and ratify the appointment of Enrome LLP as independent auditor for the year ending December 31, 2026. A share consolidation proposal was also passed authorizing the board to determine a ratio ranging from 1-for-2 to 1-for-100. No special situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present; this is a routine meeting results filing.
